I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I confirmed I'd noted 261 seats for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal.

She said no action was needed, so that reply is the only thing I did. I didn't look for other records to compare the number against, and I didn't save it anywhere. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to have in that channel.
